outgoing.excerpt: It breeds in Africa, mainly south of the Sahara, and has been widely introduced into the West Indies and southern France.

outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: In the early days of the European colonisation of North America, the native Wild Turkey (Meleagris gallopavo) was confused with this species.
